versions.changelog: ClawScan fixes v1.2.0: verify.sh now rejects proof holes (sorry/admit) before building. Added MISTRAL_API_KEY to metadata env requirements. Added security advisory to intro section. Improved verify.sh template in docs.

Restructured to API-first approach. Direct curl + Python API examples as primary usage. Sub-agent delegation moved to optional appendix. Added pass@N bash retry loop. Added metadata.requires.bins: [lake].

Initial release: Formal verification using Lean 4 + Leanstral (labs-leanstral-2603, Mistral, 119B MoE). Free tier available. Features: 5 workflow patterns (verify, spec-driven, root-cause, refactoring, state machines), FLTEval benchmarks (pass@16 beats Sonnet), pass@N strategy, comprehensive best practices, verify.sh setup script, worked example with 13 proven theorems.
